approval.statement: User explicitly authorized continuing the Graph Harness SHIP lifecycle beyond a single feature until the product reaches a terminal completion state.
approval.scope: Internal Strategy authoring/decision UI, same-origin API proxy, local development seed, tests and review evidence only; no Firmes implementation, production deployment, paid cloud resources, spending, publication, citizen contact, targeting, persuasion or mobilization.

critic_findings.finding: Successful Strategy mutations redirected to unregistered subanchors and could fall back to the command overview.
critic_findings.repair: Route Strategy section and decision success redirects to the registered strategy-room anchor and assert chapter path/hash in route tests.

critic_findings.finding: The human-decision form and objective owner initially preselected the first available option or Team role.
critic_findings.repair: Require explicit option and role choices with disabled blank placeholders; retain backend reference validation.

critic_findings.finding: Next client chapter navigation could change URL while leaving the body empty after a completed journey.
critic_findings.repair: Use native full-document navigation for chapter destinations and remove experimental view-transition integration; browser reproduction confirms the destination workspace renders.

critic_findings.finding: Reviewed-empty Strategy assessment must never erase a non-empty collection.
critic_findings.repair: Fail closed when contradictions or red-team findings are non-empty and prove no update occurs.

critic_findings.finding: Strategy authoring must remain human-authored and cannot become automated political recommendation or authority escalation.
critic_findings.repair: Keep references bounded, require exact grants, derive readiness from backend state, require explicit human decision, and perform no option ranking, targeting, persuasion or external action.

post_merge_verification.root_cause: Graph Harness correctly rejected merged PR #178 while C3-FRONT-014 still recorded REVIEWED; no Strategy functional regression was observed.
post_merge_verification.repair: This reconciliation marks C3-FRONT-014 MERGED_TO_MAIN and activates the next product-completion node before re-running exact-head and post-merge gates.
